command: require "yaml"; c=YAML.load_file(".github/workflows/ci.yml"); j=c.fetch("jobs"); abort "missing documentary job" unless j.key?("contracts"); w=j.fetch("workspace"); m=w.fetch("strategy").fetch("matrix").fetch("include"); abort "unexpected hosts" unless m.map{|x|x.fetch("host")}.sort == ["aarch64-apple-darwin","x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu"]; s=w.fetch("steps"); %w[Lint Test Build].each{|n|abort "unlocked #{n}" unless s.find{|x|x["name"]==n}.fetch("run").include?("--locked")}; abort "hidden failure" if s.any?{|x|x["continue-on-error"]}; puts "matrix: Linux x86_64 + macOS arm64; documentary check retained; Rust locked checks block on failure"
stdout: matrix: Linux x86_64 + macOS arm64; documentary check retained; Rust locked checks block on failure
